title: Chapter 883
text:
After leaving the Ruler's government building, on the way to the guest house, Han Xiao's communicator suddenly rang. He took it out and saw that it was a call from Milizaus.

"Black Star, you've arrived at Planet Crimson Ring?" Milizaus chuckled.

"Yeah, you're here too? I don't think I saw you. "

"Not yet. We're having a remote meeting. Come online."

"Okay." Han Xiao entered the quantum network, found an encrypted channel, and projected his image.

The next moment, his vision blurred, and he found himself in a huge room. In front of him was a round table surrounded by more than a dozen thrones. His remote projection was sitting on one of the thrones. At this time, most of the thrones had projections, and only four were missing.

Han Xiao looked around. The other projections were all dynasty allies, which was equivalent to the group chat of the Red Empire's Beyond Grade As.

Usually, there was no one to organize it, so the group chat was empty. Now, most of the dynasty's Beyond Grade As were online, and many of them were familiar faces. 'Dragon King' Milizaus, 'Incineration' Beyoni, 'Spaceship Emperor' Maximiler, 'Arcane Fox' Ravenlaude, 'Star Slayer' Viru, and Ty-Ty were online as well. 'Dark Emperor' Clottey and another one of the dynasty's Three Pillars were not online.

"Haha, Black Star is here." Beyoni was the most enthusiastic, and his whole body glowed brightly.

Everyone nodded at Han Xiao and took the initiative to greet him. The two brothers who fought side by side in the battle of Planet Lighthouse had the most intimate tone. Maximiler was also the friendliest, while Ravenlaude and Heber were indifferent. The others had equal attitudes, but they all had some respect.

After the battle of Planet Lighthouse, Han Xiao had the record of capturing a Beyond Grade A alive. Not only did he establish his position in the outside world, but his authority in the circle of the dynasty's Beyond Grade A allies also increased.

Although Han Xiao was a newcomer to the dynasty's Beyond Grade A circle not long ago, he had already received the respect of his colleagues and was officially accepted into the circle. Furthermore, he had made it to a relatively middle-level position, which was higher than some ordinary Beyond Grade As. No one would deliberately provoke him like they did when they first met him.

After all, the strong were respected, and the Beyond Grade As valued strength more.

In the face of his colleagues' kindness, Han Xiao responded one by one.

After exchanging pleasantries, the organizer of the gathering, Milizaus, spoke.

"The other four fellows aren't coming, so there's no need to consider them. Let's discuss … Everyone knows that the dynasty has decided to send at least three Beyond Grade As to surround EsGod. They've prepared a few name lists, but they have to ask for our opinion first. Black Star doesn't need to be mentioned. He's determined to kill EsGod, and I plan to help as well. Who else is interested?"

The way the Universal Civilizations commanded the Beyond Grade As was not a simple command. As long as it was not a crucial operation, most of the time, they would consider the wishes of the Beyond Grade As themselves and would not force their allies. Therefore, the Beyond Grade A allies of the three Universal Civilizations all had private meetings to exchange their opinions.

Everyone was deep in thought, glancing at Han Xiao from time to time.

Han Xiao looked around and noticed Milizaus throwing a glance at him. He thought about it for a moment and understood.

Milizaus had learned about Han Xiao's determination to kill EsGod from the dynasty and purposely gathered most of the dynasty's Beyond Grade As to give Han Xiao a chance to find helpers and teammates.

This old dragon is really something … Han Xiao sighed.

This time, Beyoni shrugged and said, "Black Star, you were also present when we fought EsGod the last time. It's not that I don't want to help you, but I'm an Esper, and EsGod counters me. If you want me to go, you might as well let the other Espers go. I won't take up the slot."

Han Xiao nodded. Indeed, EsGod had Super Silence, which countered most Espers. Beyoni was right. He would not be able to go.

However, understanding was one thing, but he still had to despise him.

Heh, little brother.

One word, noob!

Seeing that no one said anything, Han Xiao spoke.

"The Ruler has already revealed some information to me. This time, the dynasty will not be acting alone. The Radiant Federation and the Arcane Church will also join in. This is not just a formality but the best chance to get rid of EsGod … Personally, I will not let go of this opportunity. If anyone is willing to help me, I will thank them after the matter is done."

Hearing this, many people's eyes sparkled. Black Star was saying that if they helped him get rid of EsGod, they would definitely get a share of the Evolution Cube.

"I'll participate." Ravenlaude was the first to speak. He had been looking forward to the Evolution Cube for a long time.

"Okay, who else?" Milizaus said calmly.

As an Ancient One, he did not get along well with Ravenlaude. Although their relationship was not good, he acknowledged Ravenlaude's strength. A normal Beyond Grade A would not be able to become an Ancient One. After all, this was an operation that Black Star valued, so Milizaus hoped to help him choose some stronger teammates.

As for the other two pillars of the dynasty, there was no need to consider them. Clottey was guarding Uranril, and the other one was guarding a Star Field.

Heber was also a little moved, but he couldn't bring himself to do it, so he kept a straight face and didn't say anything.

Some rejected, some were not interested, and some accepted. In the end, more than half of the Beyond Grade A allies decided to participate in this operation. Including Han Xiao, there were a total of seven people.

Milizaus, Maximiler, Ravenlaude, Viru, Kohler, and Lotus Swordsman. These six would be the teammates participating in this operation to eliminate EsGod. Kohler was a Pugilist, and Lotus Swordsman was a female Psychic. After a round of calculations, there was not a single Esper in the team.

"Isn't seven a little too many? Will the dynasty agree?" Ravenlaude questioned.

"If the dynasty doesn't agree, we'll help as individuals. What can the dynasty do?" Lotus Swordsman's tone was cold.

The Red Empire had originally expected three to five people, but because of Han Xiao's reward from the Evolution Cube, the team had reached seven people, which exceeded the dynasty's expectations.

However, the dynasty did not have any objections to this. They could not stop their allies from privately asking for help, and it was not a bad thing.

Han Xiao turned around and sized this female Psychic up. She had long white hair, and her skin was purplish-blue with stripes. Her facial features were slightly similar to a human's, and she was very beautiful even in the eyes of the Human Race. She gave off a dreamy aura and had a unique sense of beauty.

'Lotus Swordsman' was her name, not her nickname. 'Swordsman' was her surname, and 'Lotus' was her given name.

She came from a unique race called the Rainis Race. This race did not have any gender before the age of fifteen, but when they reached fifteen, their bodies would undergo a unique change. They could turn into a male or female on their own. According to the customs of the Rainis Race, once their gender was determined, they could not change it in the future.

Therefore, society placed a lot of emphasis on division of labor and cooperation. However, the Gender Determination Ceremony determined their fate, and there were too many people who chose to turn into males every year. Even though society kept raising the status and benefits of females, the fertility rate was still decreasing year after year.

Therefore, the Rainis Race had set a quota for the number of people who had to turn into females every year to ensure the continuation of the race. Lotus Swordsman was a member of the Rainis Race who was unfortunately chosen when she was young and was forced to turn into a female.

Therefore, although the Rainis Race had a Beyond Grade A, they did not receive any protection. Lotus Swordsman was independent of the civilization and operated her own organization. She had publicly announced that the Rainis Race had nothing to do with her.

His other teammate, Kohler, was a lone Beyond Grade A who had completely sided with the dynasty. He did not have any organization and was a purebred muscular tyrant. He was not as strong as Heber, but he was still a Beyond Grade A combatant.

"I'll be counting on you guys then." Han Xiao suppressed his emotions and nodded to express his gratitude.

After discussing for a while more, the gathering ended. Milizaus went to inform the dynasty, and the remote projections all went offline.

Han Xiao exited the quantum network and exhaled excitedly.

The teammates had been decided. The dynasty had sent out seven people, and together with the other two parties, there would be more than ten Beyond Grade As. It would probably reach the scale of the battle on Planet Lighthouse.

Furthermore, with so many people against EsGod, EsGod's situation would be much worse than the dynasty's during the battle on Planet Lighthouse.

Han Xiao clenched his fists excitedly. The situation before the battle was in his favor!

—

I went to get my certificate in the afternoon and delayed writing for quite a while. My word count is a little lower today, so I booked the tickets a few days ago to watch 'Purple Potato Monster 2: How to Lose with Flying Dragon Face Riding' tonight. I'll be a little genius who is immune to spoilers.
